claim.minimallyRevisedParagraph:
For fixed $E\in\mathbb{N}_{>0}$, $\Delta>0$, $\varepsilon\geq0$, and $0<\delta<1-e^{-E}$, along integer horizons $T\geq E$, the calibrated offset satisfies\n\[\frac{\Delta}{\sigma_{E,T}}-\sqrt{2\log T}\longrightarrow\Phi^{-1}\!\left(-\frac{\log(1-\delta)}{E}\right).\]
This offset component is formally proved by `OffsetBridge.fixedEpochOffsetBridge`; the leading and variance-equivalent conclusions remain at their prior assessment status.

claim.rationale: The general fixed-participation theorem already proves the quantile offset for the capped schedule. The fixed-epoch rate lemma identifies q_T = min(1,E/T), and its calibration definition unfolds to the same sampled-Gaussian calibration at horizon E+extra. Since E+extra >= E > 0, the logarithmic scale is exactly sqrt(2 log T). The compiled adapter closes this precise correspondence gap. A checked formal derivation is distinct from a model-attributed claim-to-source mapping: only this Lean statement and its dependencies are formally checked here.
